result.summary: The page is mostly usable, but there is one clearly broken data display and a minor carousel clipping issue.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows “€NaN delivery”, indicating a missing or invalid delivery fee value being rendered as NaN.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined delivery fees and format valid numeric values; show a fallback such as “Delivery unavailable” or hide the fee until data loads.

issues.description: The rightmost “Fastest near you” card and restaurant name are clipped at the screen edge, making “Trattoria Piccol…” truncated.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel padding/peek amount or card width so partially visible items look intentionally scrollable without cutting off key text.
